$comment: Komodash Field catalog overlay (ADR-0004). Maps Komorebi static-config-schema paths to human labels, descriptions, sections, and widget hints. Anything not in `fields` falls into the 'Other' section with raw schema metadata. Maintained in-repo; ships in-binary.

border.label: Show window border
border.description: Draw a coloured border around the focused window so it's easy to see what has focus.

border_width.label: Border width (px)
border_width.description: Thickness of the focus border in pixels.

border_offset.label: Border offset (px)
border_offset.description: Distance between the window edge and the border. Negative values overlap.

border_style.label: Border style
border_style.description: How the border is drawn — system rounded, square, or follows Windows 11 corners.

border_colours.label: Border colours
border_colours.description: Per-state colours: focused window, unfocused window, monocle layout, stack indicator.

animation.label: Animation settings
animation.description: Whether windows animate when moved or resized, and how fast.

default_workspace_padding.label: Workspace padding (px)
default_workspace_padding.description: Space between the workspace edge and the tiled windows.

default_layout.label: Default layout
default_layout.description: How windows tile when first added to a workspace. Per-workspace overrides take precedence.

mouse_follows_focus.label: Mouse follows focus
mouse_follows_focus.description: Move the mouse cursor to the focused window when focus changes via hotkey.

focus_follows_mouse.label: Focus follows mouse
focus_follows_mouse.description: DEPRECATED upstream — use the masir project instead.

cross_monitor_move_behaviour.label: Cross-monitor move behaviour
cross_monitor_move_behaviour.description: What happens when you move a window past the edge of one monitor onto the next.

cross_boundary_behaviour.label: Cross-boundary focus behaviour
cross_boundary_behaviour.description: What happens when focus tries to leave the current monitor or workspace.

unmanaged_window_operation_behaviour.label: Unmanaged-window operation behaviour
unmanaged_window_operation_behaviour.description: Whether tiling operations should still apply when an unmanaged window is focused.

window_hiding_behaviour.label: Window-hiding behaviour
window_hiding_behaviour.description: How Komorebi hides windows when switching workspaces — Hide is fastest, Minimize is friendliest to taskbar pinning.

global_work_area_offset.label: Global work-area offset
global_work_area_offset.description: Reserve space at the edges of every monitor for taskbars, panels, or a Komorebi bar.

stackbar.label: Stack bar
stackbar.description: Tab strip shown above stacked windows so you can see what's behind the visible one.

bar_configurations.label: Bar configurations
bar_configurations.description: Paths to Komorebi bar configuration files to launch alongside Komorebi.

transparency.label: Window transparency
transparency.description: Make unfocused windows partly transparent so the focused one stands out.

monitors.label: Per-monitor workspaces
monitors.description: Named workspaces and per-workspace layouts for each monitor. Leave empty to use Komorebi's anonymous defaults.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Colour palette applied to the bar, stack indicator, and border colours when no per-state override is set.

border_z_order.label: Border z-order
border_z_order.description: DEPRECATED upstream from komorebi v0.1.31 — no longer required.

invisible_borders.label: Invisible borders
invisible_borders.description: DEPRECATED upstream from komorebi v0.1.22 — no longer required.

ignore_rules.label: Ignore rules
ignore_rules.description: Edit on the App Rules page — hand-editing here would create parallel sources of truth.

floating_applications.label: Floating apps
floating_applications.description: Edit on the App Rules page — hand-editing here would create parallel sources of truth.

manage_rules.label: Manage rules
manage_rules.description: Edit on the App Rules page — hand-editing here would create parallel sources of truth.

layered_applications.label: Layered apps
layered_applications.description: Power-user app-targeting list. Edit komorebi.json directly if you need it.

object_name_change_applications.label: Object-name-change apps
object_name_change_applications.description: Power-user app-targeting list. Edit komorebi.json directly if you need it.

tray_and_multi_window_applications.label: Tray / multi-window apps
tray_and_multi_window_applications.description: Power-user app-targeting list. Edit komorebi.json directly if you need it.

remove_titlebar_applications.label: Remove-titlebar apps
remove_titlebar_applications.description: Power-user app-targeting list. Edit komorebi.json directly if you need it.

slow_application_identifiers.label: Slow-app identifiers
slow_application_identifiers.description: Power-user app-targeting list. Edit komorebi.json directly if you need it.

transparency_ignore_rules.label: Transparency-ignore rules
transparency_ignore_rules.description: Power-user app-targeting list. Edit komorebi.json directly if you need it.

border_overflow_applications.label: Border-overflow apps
border_overflow_applications.description: Power-user app-targeting list. Edit komorebi.json directly if you need it.
